review:
Savannah Legend is a 5x4 African wildlife slot where wilds on reels 2 to 4 can carry 2x or 3x multipliers, which multiply each other in the same win. Pragmatic Play advertises wins up to 10,000x.

Three to five scatters award 8 to 20 free spins. In the bonus, every wild carries a 2x or 3x multiplier and a Special Lion symbol is unlocked. Each lion collected transforms into the top symbol, and collecting 4, 7, 13 and 15 lions upgrades the giraffe, zebra, hyena and meerkat into the highest-paying symbol too. The RTP is 96.5%. The symbol upgrades make long bonuses much stronger.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
